heroHeadline: Twelve Drone Breaches Since August 9 as Five-Drone Wave Hits Hours Before Independence Day, Debris Found Near Chisinau
heroSubtitle: Moldova's airspace has now been breached twelve times since August 9, with the pace sharply accelerating in the past week: a drone crossed via Vulcănești into Romania on August 24 (prompting a Romanian F-16 scramble), a Russian Shahed-type drone struck the Vynohradivka border checkpoint on August 25 — the third border-crossing strike in two weeks — and a single drone crossed near Palanca on August 26. Overnight into August 27, five separate drones crossed the Ștefan Vodă frontier in the hours before Moldova's 35th Independence Day; President Sandu called the overflights "intimidation." Wreckage was also found near the Chisinau-Basarabeasca highway on August 27 — only the second debris find on Moldovan soil since the August 9 Crocmaz incident. The escalation continues against the backdrop of Moscow's May 15 passportisation decree and Deputy Foreign Minister Galuzin's August 10 warning that any armed provocation against Transnistria would be treated as an attack on Russia.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
